# P8 owned acceptance driver stop

Status: accepted for the independent test driver; live packaged validation pending.

The previous real-model loop had no external normal-stop control. Its owned
client was forcibly terminated and that failure remains in the historical
report. Add a local finite request file scoped to the fresh run and already
submitted case/turn. Reuse the existing owned child IPC and product abort;
do not introduce a server, generic RPC, arbitrary script or product feature.

Acknowledgment and lifecycle completion are different facts. Require the
bound terminal metric record and inactive task before strict client shutdown.
Keep one abort operation, permit retry only for the helper's explicit busy
refusal, and retain unknown response/timeout failures. A stopped creative
acceptance run is never a passing creation result.

The dated subsequent user authorization removed request and cumulative-token
caps. Make that explicit in test configuration while retaining the original
16-cap default as a compatibility test. Continue all new admissions in one
exclusive sibling journal and report the prior immutable 50 admissions
separately. Neither the original evidence nor product context/output guards
are modified.
